summary: The argument holds and the evidence is sound, but the strongest number is under-qualified and the determinism section promises more than the brief reserves for it.

issues.evidence: Source claim c1 is marked as requiring qualification.
issues.brief_ref: Every stated number carries the conditions it was measured under.
issues.recommended_correction: State the warm-cache condition in the same sentence as the figure, not two clauses later.

issues.evidence: Brief reserved material: the determinism argument is reserved for the follow-up article.

issues.description: The determinism point is asserted rather than explained; a reader who has not thought about cache correctness will not follow why it matters.
